tabs.tab_title: Do I need any prior yoga experience or physical flexibility?
tabs.tab_content: No prior experience or flexibility is required! Brain Yoga focuses on gentle bilateral coordination drills, neurobic finger movements, eye relaxation, and desk-friendly breathwork that anyone can perform while comfortably seated.

tabs.tab_title: Do we need yoga mats or athletic gym clothes?
tabs.tab_content: No! Brain Yoga for Busy Minds requires zero gym wear or mats. All neurobic movements, eye exercises, and breathwork are performed while comfortably seated on an office chair in regular formal or casual work clothes.

tabs.tab_title: How much time do these practices take on a busy workday?
tabs.tab_content: Each individual technique takes just 3 to 5 minutes. You can practice them during natural workday transitions—between meetings, before opening an email sprint, or when taking a quick break.

tabs.tab_title: Can sessions be organized for our remote/hybrid corporate team?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, absolutely! We host live, highly engaging virtual workshops via Zoom or Microsoft Teams with cameras on, interactive polls, and real-time guidance. In-person corporate campus workshops are also available across Hyderabad and other cities.

tabs.tab_title: How is Brain Yoga different from regular meditation apps?
tabs.tab_content: Meditation apps often ask an already exhausted mind to sit in silent concentration. Brain Yoga uses bilateral movement, neurobics, and EFT tapping to actively engage the nervous system first, making mental calm natural and effortless.

tabs.tab_title: How soon can our company schedule a corporate session?
tabs.tab_content: We can typically schedule corporate workshops with 3 to 5 business days advance notice to customize the curriculum around your team's specific pain points and timings.
